title: Entitled Girlfriend Causes Complete Chaos During Arrest
description:
On January 4th, 2023, an officer responded to a case of domestic battery. Dispatch advised that a female had called to inform them that her boyfriend wasn’t leaving her house even after her repeated requests. The officer had previous experience with domestic battery at the given location, so he was familiar with both parties. The female's behavior left the officer with no choice but to put her in handcuffs. She was taken to the police unit, but that only momentarily stopped her from acting aggressively. The female began having panic attacks and requesting her medicine. She was soon transported to the hospital. The female was charged with battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
